stages.note: Shipped/recorded post-export stage (kevin-colour 2026-11-18): resolves hair_color black to [0.035, 0.028, 0.022] and re-tints scalp + brow baseColorFactor only; BIN chunk byte-identical. Replayable: the tool is python3 -I safe (sibling import via sys.path from __file__), and provenance/phenotype are hash-pinned inputs materialized to {outdir}/.inputs, so the resolved argv equals the recorded byteLineage argv modulo input staging (proven by the stage-21 execution test in run-chain.test.ts).

stages.name: collar_sleeve_opening_unhide_v1
stages.note: Shipped post-export stage (kevin-collar S3 2026-11-18): moves the hide-mask triangles inside the scrub collar/V-neck opening and both sleeve hems back to skin on the shipped GLB bytes (post-stage-21 input). Generalizes the physician neckline un-hide: absent --openings-spec reproduces the physician 2faef74a->8c3ab05c bytes exactly; the pinned spec selects neckline+sleeves, adding the opening-edge pass (kept in-band triangles with a clear ray to a grading-camera position derived from the file's own bounds, no body-specific constants). S9 adds the pinned visibility selection (--select-tris, the S7 T_open 132 minus the 6 open L tris = SELECTED 126, E/s7a v-select-65 selected verbatim, total asserted by the S9 chain driver): selection may only narrow, never widen. Python3 -I safe; the spec and the selection are hash-pinned inputs materialized to {outdir}/.inputs (proven by the stage-22 execution test in run-chain.test.ts).

stages.name: collar_sleeve_skin_footprint_inpaint_v1
stages.note: Shipped post-export stage (kevin-collar S5 2026-11-18): fills the hide-mask footprint of the skin baseColor from its own texels on the stage-22 output (Telea per-island inpaint, radius 3). Reuses the nurse hide-footprint tool unchanged (no new inpaint algorithm); the mask is the hide-mask raster (derive-fixture from pre 40492951, 220972 texels, 7 hidden prims / 2278 tris), which covers the moved set (M subset H, 36019 texels). M-only fill leaves 47% of M black (sources black H\M padding); H fill clears M to min maxc 172. Python3 -I safe; mask hash-pinned to {outdir}/.inputs (proven by the stage-23 execution test in run-chain.test.ts).
